sources.title: Wikipedia: Indeed
sources.quote: Indeed, Inc. is an American multinational employment website for job listings launched in November 2004.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Indeed
sources.quote: It is headquartered in Austin, Texas, and Stamford, Connecticut, with additional offices around the world.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Indeed
sources.quote: Indeed was cofounded by Paul Forster and Rony Kahan in 2004 in both Austin, Texas, and Stamford, Connecticut.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Indeed
sources.quote: On October 1, 2012, Indeed was acquired by Japan-based Recruit Co. Ltd., becoming an independent operating unit.

sources.title: Wikipedia: LinkedIn
sources.quote: LinkedIn is an American business and employment-oriented social networking service used globally.

sources.title: Wikipedia: LinkedIn
sources.quote: Founded and headquartered in Mountain View, California, LinkedIn has 36 global offices as of February 11, 2024.

sources.title: Wikipedia: LinkedIn
sources.quote: The company was founded in December 2002

sources.title: Wikipedia: LinkedIn
sources.quote: In December 2016, Microsoft purchased LinkedIn for $26.2 billion, being its largest acquisition at the time.

notes.text: Microsoft ended LinkedIn operations in China in October 2021.
